title: Inventory
wikitext:
[[File:Empty inventory window.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Empty inventory window.]] [[File:Filled inventory window.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Used inventory window.]] The [[Inventory]] window is a panel which displays all the [[item]]s, [[armor]], [[container]]s, [[gold]], and [[platinum]] a [[character]] is currently carrying or using. ==User interface== The panel toggles open or closed by pressing the default key "I" on the keyboard. The panel is divided into the top half for [[equipment]], and the bottom half for the bags. *The top half displays all the equipped armor, as well as the character wearing it, and can be switched to display the same for heroes currently in the party. *The bottom half displays all the containers, as well as the contents of the currently selected one, and can be switched to display the contents of each. Items can be [[w:Drag and drop|dragged and dropped]] from one container into another to either move them around, or to the top half to equip or unequip them. In the bottom half, items can be dragged and dropped between slots and containers. [[w:Double-click|Double-clicking]] equipment that is not currently equipped will also equip it. When not in a [[guild hall]], [[outpost]], [[town]], or [[Player versus Player|PvP]] area, [[trade]]able items can be dragged and dropped on the ground. The inventory is also the interface for trading or using [[vault box|account-wide storage]]. ==Layout and usage== The screenshots to the right are examples of an empty and a full inventory panel. The numbered items below correspond with the numbers marked on the screenshot. Toggleable armor can be set to ''Always Show'', ''Hide in Towns and Outposts'', ''Hide in Combat Areas'', or ''Always Hide''. In PvP, the guild cape always shows and costumes always hide. 1. '''[[Hero]] slots''' - Click these icons to switch (only) the equipment view to that of any hero currently in the [[party]].
2. '''[[Guild cape|Cape]]''' - The [[guild]] cape toggle.
3. '''[[Template:Headgear nav|Helm]]''' - The headgear toggle.
4. '''[[Armor]]''' - Equipped armor pieces.
5. '''[[Weapon]]s''' - Equipped weapon and [[off-hand]] item.
6. '''[[Costume]]''' - Non-armor costume headpiece and costume body. ''Toggleable.''
7. '''[[Currency]]''' - The amount of [[gold]] and [[platinum]] currently carried.
8. '''[[Weapon set]]s''' - Click this icon to select how many weapon sets are displayed on the [[user interface]].
9. '''Item [[container]]s''' - The item containers that can be equipped on a character; click these icons to switch (only) the backpack view to that of any container currently equipped (from left to right: [[backpack]], [[belt pouch]], two [[bag]]s, and one [[equipment pack]]). The icon is grayed out if the container has not been equipped; to equip a container, double-click or drag and drop it onto the grayed-out icon.
10. '''Destroy item''' - Drag and drop an item onto this icon to destroy or delete it ''permanently''. It can never be recovered, so confirmation will be requested whenever attempting to delete an item.
11. '''Inventory contents''' - The items, displayed in slots, in the currently selected item container.
12. '''[[Character]]''' - The selected character or hero is shown here, wearing all the equipped armor if it is toggled on, and updated in real-time. Click and drag to rotate the display.
13. '''[[PvP Equipment]]''' / '''Identify All'''.
:* PvP Equipment - Displayed only on [[PvP-only character]]s, these buttons allow saving, loading, and viewing PvP Equipment [[template]]s, and creating PvP equipment.
:* Identify All - Displayed only on [[Roleplaying character]]s, this button can be used to [[identify]] all unidentified items. It was added with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401#Inventory management upgrades|April 1st, 2026 update]].
==Inventory Bags== The '''Inventory Bags''' window (default key: "F9") is a simplified panel which displays all the [[item]]s a [[character]] is currently carrying in their bags. The panel toggles open or closed by pressing the default key "F9" on the keyboard. It is resizable. It can show all the items in the bags in a condensed view if the option "Show collapsed inventory bag view" has been enabled in the [[General settings]]. == Notes == * A character can expand their inventory by equipping more containers. * Heroes share the character's inventory and all the items in it. * Although a hero's armor cannot be changed directly, their weapon and offhand can be changed in the inventory. ** However, a hero's weapon cannot be dyed while equipped. ** Hero armor can be change by visiting a [[Hero armorer]]. ** Hero armor can be upgraded with [[runes]] and/or [[insignias]]. * Even if a 2-handed weapon is equipped, an offhand item can be equipped (though it will have no effect); therefore, each hero also allows one extra slot to "store" offhand items. * [[Container]]s can be [[dye]]d. ** Equipment packs, Charr Bags, and Zehtuka's Pack can be dyed, but do not show any change in color. * Gold automatically converts to platinum whenever it reaches 1000 ({{gold}}). A character can hold no more than 100 platinum ({{platinum}}) in their inventory. * Pressing F5, F6, F7 or F8 displays each individual container's contents, and the equipment above. Pressing F9 shows the whole inventory except the equipment (and equipment pack), character, and currency. * If the inventory is full and an NPC wants to give an item, the chat log displays an error message in blue: ''"{NPC} tries to hands you a {item}, but your inventory is full."'' The NPC's dialogue changes to ''"Your inventory is full. Please make room and speak to me again."'' (These are the actual in-game messages and retain their original wording.) * The "Identify All" feature will not identify any equipped weapon. It will also not identify items stored in the xunlai chest, and conversely identification kit stored in the xunlai chest will not be consumed for this shortcut.
